hints.content:
Different words can represent different mathematical operations.

What operation is suggested when we say "$j \goldE{\text{ minus }} 5$?"

[[☃ explanation 1]]

options.explanation:
Statement | Operation | Expression
- | - | -
*$3$ more than $7$* | Addition | $3+7$
*$2$ less than $10$* | Subtraction | $10-2$
*The product of $2$ and $7$* | Multiplication | $2\cdot 7$ or $2(7)$
*The quotient of $8$ and $2$* | Division | $8 \div 2$ or $\dfrac82$
